title: governance-kit community pack catalog
description: Advisory index of known community packs. Presence in this catalog is not required for `governance pack add` to work with an arbitrary `gh:<owner>/<repo>` ref — the catalog is a discoverability layer, not a gate.

version.description: Schema version of this catalog file. Bumped when the entry shape changes incompatibly.

id.description: Scoped pack id of the form `<author>/<slug>`, e.g. `acme/soc2`.

summary.description: One-line description of the pack's scope.

category.description: Grouping label (e.g. `compliance`, `frontend`, `devops`). Advisory; the catalog does not enumerate allowed values.

ref.description: For GitHub, `<owner>/<repo>` (branch/SHA pinning happens in `.governance/packs.lock`, not here).

path.description: Optional subpath within the source repo where the pack lives. Defaults to the repo root.

min_governance_kit.description: Minimum governance-kit version the pack declares it needs. Mirrored from the pack's `pack.yaml`.
